next.reason: §2023:13.18.60.4 GR11 repeats 1985 GR9 (radix 10, minimum digit configuration, implementor-specified alignment/representation/sign, storage for the PICTURE range; DOC-A.1-215) and adds a case in the same rule: 'If the WITH NO SIGN phrase is specified the representation ... reserves no storage for representing any sign value', 'always considered to have a zero, or positive value'. USAGE PACKED-DECIMAL WITH NO SIGN, refused by the 1985 format, is accepted: a case added.
